description:
Hello,
 Greetings…
 

 Please have a look at the requirement below and let me know your interest
 

 Sharepoint Developer  
 Burlington, NC  
 3 Months 
 

 Sharepoint Developer III, 6-10 years experience
 Share point 2013/MVC5/C#/Entity Framework with OracleThe person in this role will architect, design and develop SharePoint Apps for SP version 2013. He will be using C# and MVC-5 for apps development. He should have knowledge/experience on using Entity Framework with Oracle. He should be good at UI Designing. He should be well equipped to handle the complex situations posed by the environment e.g. Reverse Proxy/Kerberos Authentication. He will also be responsible for training team members to get along with him on the project.
 

 


 Share point 2013/MVC5/C#/Entity Framework with Oracle, Reverse Proxy/Kerberos Authentication
